title: R1 Neo: Device identity
description: Validate lichen_hal_identity_get() on R1 Neo. board_name should be 'r1_neo', zephyr_board should match CONFIG_BOARD. Verify capability flags match enabled DTS nodes.
close_reason: Fixed: Made test_identity_reports_board_and_caps board-agnostic by checking against CONFIG_LICHEN_BOARD_NAME (or CONFIG_BOARD fallback) instead of hardcoding 'native-hal-test'. Test now validates R1 Neo identity correctly with board_name='r1_neo' and capability flags matching DTS nodes.
